spec.title: A timing model for a forest pest: Candy's 1991 slope of -0.0457
spec.statement: Candy (Environmental Entomology, 1991) modelled how spruce budworm, a forest pest, moves through its life stages as the season warms. He reports a slope of -0.0457 for the cumulative logit model. This re-runs an independent R replication by Boersch-Supan, published in ReScience C, on the same counts.

source.authors: Replication: P. H. Boersch-Supan. Original: S. G. Candy.

metric.name: slope of the cumulative logit model
